title: Lead React Native Engineer
description:
We’re hiring our first mobile engineer in São Paulo to own the React Native app end to end and partner directly with the founder on product, architecture, and user experience.


Company Description

Glitch is building the personal AI trading assistant. Think ChatGPT for financial markets.


We believe the era of scrolling through trading apps is ending. The future is a personal AI companion that knows your goals, watches the markets while you sleep, and helps you build wealth across prediction markets, crypto, stocks, and everything in between.


We're a small, scrappy team, backed by leading U.S. investors, and looking to build a base in São Paulo. We ship fast, have a vision for the future, and obsess over craft. If you've ever wished financial tools felt more like the best consumer apps on your phone and less like a Bloomberg Terminal, this is your opportunity to build it.


Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for a Lead React Native Engineer based in São Paulo, Brazil. You'll be the founding mobile engineer at Glitch, the person who owns the iOS and Android experience end to end. This isn't a "ticket-taker" role.


We want someone product-oriented who brings strong ideas for features and improvements, not just someone implementing tickets. You'll be building new kinds of mobile interfaces for AI products: dynamic surfaces, conversational workflows, and composable UI systems that can adapt to user context in real time.


If you are an active trader of prediction markets, crypto, or stocks, that’s a huge plus.


Day to day, you'll be:

  • Owning the architecture and development of our React Native app end to end, and defining the foundation we build on as the product evolves.
  • Designing fluid, animated interactions that make the AI feel like a living presence, not a text box
  • Implementing real-time data feeds, push notifications, and background processing for market alerts
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction. Your opinions on UX matter here, not just your code
  • Building composable UI primitives (cards, charts, widgets) that our AI agent can dynamically assemble into personalized interfaces
  • Using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to move at the pace of a full engineering team, even when you’re building solo
  • Shipping to TestFlight and the App Store, managing releases, and iterating fast based on user feedback
  • Integrating with crypto wallets, onchain transactions, and Web3 infrastructure


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of production React Native experience (or React + strong mobile interest; convince us)
  • You've shipped at least one app that real humans use and love. Show us
  • Deep comfort with TypeScript, modern React patterns (hooks, context, concurrent features), and state management
  • Experience with animations and gesture handling (Reanimated, Gesture Handler). You care about the 60fps details
  • Strong CS fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, system design. You can think, not just implement
  • Experience with real-time data (WebSockets, SSE, polling) and push notifications
  • Comfort with backend integration: REST APIs, GraphQL, authentication flows
  • Proficient with AI coding tools to increase productivity (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor)
  • Bonus: crypto/Web3 experience (wallets, transactions, onchain data)
  • Bonus: experience building chat interfaces, AI-powered UIs, or streaming LLM responses
  • Bonus: an eye for design. You notice when padding is off by 4px and it bothers you
  • Bonus: familiarity with native modules and bridging when React Native isn't enough


Who You Are

  • Scrappy. You'd rather ship something imperfect today than architect the perfect system for a month. You can go from zero to prototype in a weekend
  • Opinionated about craft. You have taste. You've used an app and thought "this animation is wrong" and you could explain why. You care about the details that make software feel good
  • Excited about the frontier. AI-native interfaces, prediction markets, crypto — this isn't a job where you maintain a CRUD app. The product we're building barely has precedent.
  • Low-ego, high-output. Small team. Everyone does everything. You'll pair with the founder, debate product decisions, and push code in the same afternoon
  • Builder energy. You make things on the side. You have a GitHub with projects. You get excited about new libraries and try them at 2am. You can't help it


Why Glitch

  • Compensation. R$25,000–R$35,000 BRL/month + meaningful early-stage equity, depending on experience and scope.
  • High ownership, high standards. This is an early-stage company with a fast pace and a high bar for craft, judgment, and execution. It’s a great fit for someone who wants outsized responsibility and rapid growth.
  • Founding team. You will be one of the first employees. Your fingerprints will be on everything
  • São Paulo-based. In-person, high-bandwidth collaboration. We build together
  • Meaningful equity. Early-stage with significant ownership. We’re focused on building a product people love, not chasing short-term metrics
  • Work on hard problems. AI-generated interfaces, real-time market data, crypto integration, mobile-native design, all in one product
  • Ship constantly. We deploy daily. You'll see your work in users' hands fast


How To Apply

Send us a note with your GitHub (or portfolio), a link to an app you’ve shipped, what you personally owned (e.g., key features, architecture, performance work, release process), and one product decision you’d improve in a mobile app you love (and why). Also, please tell us why this role at Glitch specifically. We read every application.

title: Gerente de logística
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Como será seu dia a dia de trabalho na empresa?

  • Estruturar, planejar e gerir toda a cadeia logística, abrangendo transporte, armazenagem, movimentação e destinação de materiais e insumos.
  • Atuar de forma descentralizada, coordenando processos e equipes distribuídas em diferentes regiões, assegurando padronização e efetividade.
  • Implementar indicadores de performance logística (custos, produtividade, lead time, disponibilidade de frota, nível de serviço).
  • Conduzir processos de contratação e gestão de fornecedores de transporte, frota e armazenagem, garantindo qualidade e custo competitivo.
  • Apoiar a diretoria na definição de estratégias de expansão e otimização logística nas operações.
  • Integrar-se às áreas Comercial, Operações e demais áreas para garantir fluidez na cadeia de abastecimento e atendimento das metas de entrega.
  • Liderar equipe multidisciplinar, promovendo desenvolvimento técnico, segurança operacional e engajamento da equipe.
  • Representar a área de Logística junto à liderança e órgãos externos, propondo soluções viáveis e sustentáveis.


O que é necessário:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Logística, Supply Chain ou áreas afins será considerado diferencial.
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de operações logísticas, preferencialmente em indústrias, utilities ou operações ambientais.
  • Conhecimento sólido em gestão de frota, planejamento de rotas, controle de custos logísticos e KPIs.
  • Capacidade de liderança, comunicação clara e atuação colaborativa com áreas técnicas e administrativas.
  • Desejável vivência em contextos de reestruturação organizacional e integração de novas operações.

  • Coletar, analisar e entregar dados relacionados às Redes Sociais para avaliar o desempenho das campanhas da MadHouse TV e ajustar estratégias de acordo com os resultados;

title: Network Engineer
description:
Network Engineer – LAN/WAN (Senior / Level 3)

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer (LAN/WAN) to join our global infrastructure team. In this role, you will design, deploy, and maintain complex network environments while providing advanced Level 3 support for critical incidents. You will work closely with cross‑functional teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure high availability, security, and performance across enterprise network systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy LAN/WAN network infrastructure across enterprise environments.
  • Provide 3rd level troubleshooting for all LAN/WAN issues, alerts, and escalations.
  • Maintain and support all network monitoring and reporting systems .
  • Produce and maintain detailed technical documentation for all deployed systems and solutions.
  • Participate in on‑call rotations and provide after‑hours support as required.
  • Perform administrative tasks including time reporting and status updates.
  • Configure and install a wide range of network components (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, QoS).
  • Execute network maintenance, upgrades, patches, hotfixes, and security configurations.
  • Monitor network performance, ensuring system availability, reliability, and capacity planning .
  • Follow established change and configuration management processes for all network modifications.
  • Work with the security team to implement security tools, policies, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with vendors and internal IT teams to resolve complex issues.
  • Deliver technical training to internal teams.


Technical Qualifications

  • Strong networking background with CCNP certification (required) .
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to quickly diagnose and repair network issues.
  • Ability to communicate with customers, gather requirements, and collaborate with offshore teams.
  • Experience with SD‑WAN (Silver Peak preferred) .
  • Experience with Next‑Gen Firewalls (Cisco Firepower preferred) .
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting routing loops, asymmetric routing, and STP loop issues.
  • Expertise configuring/troubleshooting:
  • Cisco ASA, IPS
  • Cisco ISE
  • Cisco WLC (wireless)
  • Routing protocols: EIGRP, OSPF, BGP
  • LAN switching: VLAN, VTP, STP, EtherChannel
  • Quality of Service (QoS)
  • TCP/IP stack
  • Application protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SMTP, SNMP, SSL, etc.
  • Network security: IPSec/SSL VPN, Cisco AnyConnect, AAA, TACACS+, RADIUS, 802.1x
  • Experience with Cisco Catalyst and Nexus 7K/9K switches .
  • Skilled in Cisco IOS and NX‑OS configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with application load balancers and firewall cloud services (Zscaler preferred ).
  • Data Center networking experience (Nexus / ACI preferred ).
  • Ability to support enterprise apps such as SAP, Citrix, Portal, etc.
  • Ability to analyze monitoring outputs and recommend actions (e.g., CPU spikes on core devices).
  • Cloud experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with Citrix NetScaler, Cisco FTD, Aruba SD‑WAN, and Azure Cloud considered a strong advantage.


General Qualifications

  • Strong team player with excellent collaboration skills.
  • Ability to interact directly with end users to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Excellent documentation and reporting skills.
  • Self‑starter with strong initiative and problem‑solving mindset.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation abilities.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly in a dynamic environment.


Education Requirements

  • CCNP Certification (required)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  • Advanced English.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Public Policy Director LATAM
description:
Role summary

  • We are seeking an experienced Public Affairs Specialist to strengthen GS1 Global Public Policy team based in Brazil.
  • Working with the Public Policy team and reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Public Policy, the successful candidate will have 10+ years of prior experience in public policy and government engagement across Latin America (LATAM).
  • This role is a unique opportunity to set the foundation of international public policy across the LATAM region (including Central and South America) with a global perspective.
  • The successful candidate will act as a public policy strategist developing and implementing plans with GS1 Member Organisations in the LATAM Region and with Global Office.
  • They will be GS1’s day-to-day point of contact for engagement with GS1 Member Organisations and stakeholders, including governments and regulators, on all public policy matters relevant to GS1 in the region.
  • They will build constructive relationships, provide evidence-based specialist insights, and ensure GS1’s positions are understood and reflected in evolving policy frameworks for traceability, trade efficiency, and regulatory compliance across fragmented supply chains.


Education and experience

  • Master’s degree with 10+ years of related experience.
  • Stakeholder Networks: Established contacts across national and regional institutions in the LATAM region and experience in building coalitions and coordinating with multi-country stakeholders.
  • A thorough understanding of how international organisations, trade associations, and NGOs function, and work experience in international environments relevant to the region.


Desired experience

  • Sector Knowledge : Understanding of FMCG/retail and consumer goods policy environment (sustainability, product data, packaging, product safety, traceability, e-commerce).
  • Standards & Data : Familiarity with data standards and policy interoperability (preferably GS1 standards, 2D barcodes, master data, digital product information), and the role of registries in regulatory compliance.


Skills required

  • Strategic Policy Framing : Ability to connect technical standards to policy objectives (consumer protection, sustainability, market surveillance, competition, innovation).
  • Executive Relationships : Credibility with senior officials and industry leaders; ability to develop long-term trusted relationships, adept at informal/formal engagement, drafting amendments and compromise texts.
  • Communication : Excellent written and oral communication in English, Portuguese and Spanish.
  • Analytical Rigour : Strong legislative analysis, impact assessment, and risk/opportunity mapping; able to translate complex dossiers into clear executive guidance.
  • Execution & Collaboration : Comfortable operating in a federated international network; disciplined follow‑through across multiple files; high integrity and respect for competition‑law constraints.
  • Public Representation : Confident public speaker; able to present GS1’s neutral, standards‑based positions in diverse regional fora.


Additional Information

This job requires up to 25% global travel.


How to apply

Email your cover letter with CV to: ; include the job title in the subject line. Responses will be treated quickly and with strict confidentiality.

title: Supervisor(a) Manutenção Logística (Carretas)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Desafio:


Supervisionar a manutenção das carretas florestais das empresas parceiras (Transportadoras) através de inspeções rotineiras, com visitas constantes a área de manutenção das mesmas, criando o check list padrão e gerenciando as pendencias junto ao time.



Principais Atividades:


  • Liderar e auditar o desempenho das equipes próprias na realização das atividades de inspeção dos terceiros;
  • Conduzir a melhoria contínua, mapeando oportunidades, priorizando iniciativas e assegurando a implementação de ações que elevem segurança, produtividade, qualidade e eficiência de custos;
  • Participar da construção do planejamento semanal, mensal e anual de manutenção, assim como construir em conjunto com as áreas clientes como será o plano operacional dos períodos;
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe, assegurando clima organizacional positivo e alinhamento aos pilares de segurança, qualidade, produtividade e eficiência de custos, por meio de acompanhamento, orientação e suporte contínuos e participação ativa na construção e plano de recrutamento, seleção e treinamento;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade da área e diretrizes da liderança;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir as políticas de Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional e Ética/Compliance, junto a colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando aderência à legislação, compromissos corporativos e requisitos normativos (normas e ISOs aplicáveis) em atividades, produtos e serviços;
  • Realizar diagnóstico de falhas mecânicas, hidráulicas e elétricas, principalmente nos componentes que afetam diretamente segurança da operação de logística;
  • Criar relatório padrão que traga visibilidade do processo;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, especialmente NR-11, NR-12, NR-18 e NR-31 (quando aplicável);
  • Fazer interface com os terceiros para realização da atividade dentro da área deles.



Requisitos e Qualificações:


  • Ensino superior completo em Logística, Mecânica, Administração, Economia, Engenharias relacionadas às áreas florestal, civil e industrial ou áreas correlatas;

title: AI/Automation Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with some hands on experience in building AI enabled applications and automation systems. The ideal candidate will be proficient across front end and back end technologies, capable of architecting scalable solutions, and experienced in integrating systems using SDKs in a cross functional environment.

Key Responsibilities


Full Stack Engineering

• Design, build, and maintain scalable web applications, covering back end development.

• Develop clean, maintainable code and contribute to architectural decisions for new and existing applications.

• Implement MCPs, APIs, SDKs, and services that support scalable system integration.

AI & Automation Development

• Create, design, and implement automation systems to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency across platforms.

• Develop AI driven features, models, or integrations to enhance product capabilities and automation outcomes.

• Identify, analyze, and troubleshoot issues within automation systems to ensure reliable, smooth operation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with product owners, engineers, and other internal teams to align automation approaches within a predefined SDK.

• Ensure seamless integration between systems, automation layers, and partner tools.

• Collaborate on feature roadmaps, application architecture, and scalability planning.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer, with strong proficiency in both front-end and back-end frameworks (e.g., Python, AWS, Azure, Java, or similar).

• Hands-on experience working with AI/ML technologies, such as model integration, AI APIs, LLM tooling, or machine learning pipelines. Experience of using AI for productivity and efficiency capabilities using AI components

• Strong understanding of automation systems, workflow orchestration, and systems integration.

• Experience working with or developing SDK-based integrations.

• Solid understanding of cloud platforms (Azure and AWS).

• Ability to debug complex systems and deliver resilient, scalable solutions.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


What You Can Expect from Us

  • Professional development and continuous growth of your skills.
  • Opportunities to work on international assignments.
  • A collaborative, diverse, inclusive, and innovative environment that values teamwork.

title: Coordenador de Qualidade e Diligenciamento
description:
Sobre a Gruen


Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

Objetivo : Coordenar, organizar e controlar a documentação técnica de projetos de plantas de biogás, incluindo databooks, manuais de operação e manutenção, garantindo conformidade com normas técnicas, requisitos contratuais e padrões de qualidade da empresa e do cliente.

  • Coordenar a organização e atualização de manuais de operação, manutenção e instruções técnicas.
  • Garantir que toda a documentação técnica esteja em conformidade com as normas aplicáveis e com os requisitos contratuais do cliente.

Normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicadas à indústria.

Gestão de documentos técnicos (databooks, dossiês, manuais).

Por que trabalhar conosco?


Nós entendemos sua ambição e o Salem Advogados vai ao encontro dela. Você pode crescer muito mais em uma empresa em ascensão como a nossa!


Somos um grupo de empresas, com o Salem Advogados com marketing digital no mercado jurídico, expandimos para o Brasil inteiro.


Atualmente contamos com mais de 5.000 processos ativos em 14 áreas de atuação, realizando um atendimento de cerca de mais de 7.000 pessoas todos os meses por todo o Brasil.


Estamos acelerando a empresa e buscamos uma pessoa qualificada para nos ajudar a alcançar as metas.


Temos uma equipe de alta performance, e atualmente estamos com:

+5.000 processos ativos (fora os arquivados)

+85.000 novos leads por ano

+10 anos de experiência jurídica

+40 colaboradores na equipe


---------------

Detalhes sobre a vaga


  • Temos um software de CRM funil de vendas (Pipedrive) que permite registrar informações chave para facilitar criar o relacionamento
  • Já temos os leads gerados
  • O time comercial é estruturado em qualificador, fechador e pós-venda
  • Esta vaga é focada em vendas/fechador. Identificar as objeções e garantir o contrato.
  • Não gerará leads, não qualificará os leads, não fará pós-vendas depois de fechado o contrato
  • O foco é especializar para ganhar eficiência
  • No entanto, não temos cultura de braço curto. “Isso não faz parte da minha vaga” não existe aqui
  • Meta é inegociável, tem que ser batida


---------------

Candidato ideal


Há tipos diferentes de perfil de lead potencial, por isto é essencial que você tenha:

  • Capacidade analítica para entender qual lead fecha contrato e qual não fecha;
  • Capacidade analítica para entender o motivo do lead não ter fechado e ir participando da melhoria do script. Não basta apenas ligar usando o mesmo script sem entender o que está acontecendo
  • Capacidade de criar relatórios (o próprio software de vendas possui modelos prontos), com o objetivo de entender qual perfil fecha mais ou menos para focar no melhor perfil de cliente
  • Desenvolver relacionamento a fundo com clientes (rapport, aprender sobre o cliente)
  • Entender a necessidade do cliente e não apenas insistir na venda, mas construir relacionamento


---------------

Qualificações


  • 3+ anos de experiência em vendas
  • Excelente skill de comunicação
  • Habilidade de se auto-organizar e de priorização de trabalho (qual perfil de lead fecha mais e focar nestes)
  • Capacidade de analisar dados, fazer relatórios e tirar conclusões de métricas de vendas

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Gerente Geologia e Planejamento de Mina Curto Prazo

Inovação. Tecnologia e Sustentabilidade.

Com mais de 120 anos de história , presença em 20 países nos cinco continentes e mais de 13.000 colaboradores , estamos na vanguarda da tecnologia e da sustentabilidade.

✅ Óleo e Gás – soluções para exploração e extração nas condições mais extremas

✅ Indústria – tubos resistentes e leves para diversas aplicações

✅ Novas Energias – geotermia, hidrogênio e captura de carbono (CCUS)

No Brasil, contamos com uma sólida atuação e unidades estratégicas:

Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e Espirito Santo – produção de tubos de aço com e sem costura e soluções tubulares para indústria em geral

Florestal – produção de carvão vegetal para abastecimento dos altos-fornos

⛏ Mineração – fornecimento interno de minério de ferro

Com presença global e forte atuação local, nosso objetivo é estar cada vez mais próximo dos clientes , garantindo competitividade, inovação e excelência .

Resumo da posição:

Responsável pelas atividades de geologia e planejamento de lavra de curto prazo, garantindo a caracterização geológica das reservas, a definição de planos de lavra e disposição de estéril e rejeitos, assegurando a execução sustentável e econômica das operações, em conformidade com normas legais, padrões de segurança e diretrizes estratégicas da empresa, visando otimização da reserva mineral e cumprimento das metas de produção. Gestão das atividades de pesquisa mineral e estudos geológicos de longo prazo.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar as atividades de Geologia e Planejamento de Lavra de curto prazo, garantindo modelos geológicos atualizados, planos de amostragem, análises geoestatísticas e caracterização das reservas.

  • Desenvolver e revisar planos de lavra de curto prazo, integrar informações geológicas e operacionais, otimizar sequenciamento, controlar disposição de estéril e rejeitos e acompanhar o desempenho das frentes de lavra.
  • Preparar, revisar e manter relatórios técnicos, registros e documentações de conformidade, assegurando aderência às normas legais, ambientais e de segurança.
  • Planejar e gerenciar recursos financeiros, materiais, operacionais e humanos, assegurando cumprimento das metas, melhoria contínua e fortalecimento das competências do time.
  • Estabilizar a qualidade da alimentação da planta por meio da programação das massas de minério, reduzindo variabilidade natural e garantindo atendimento das especificações.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em Geologia ou Engenharia de Minas.
  • Desejável Pós-graduação, especialização ou MBA em Geologia, Geociências, Engenharia de Minas ou áreas afins.
  • Sólida experiência em funções ligadas à Geologia, Planejamento de Lavra ou liderança técnica em mineração.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em: Estatística e geoestatística, Geologia local e regional no contexto do depósito, Sondagem geológica, Interpretação de relatórios geológicos, Softwares avançados de planejamento e modelagem, Técnicas de sequenciamento e otimização de lavra

title: [Tech] Especialista Sênior em Dados
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Liderar tecnicamente o time de Dados e IA, posicionando-se como um generalista técnico com visão sistêmica, capaz de transitar entre as áreas de dados, inteligência artificial e software sem barreiras. A missão central é exercer total autonomia para arquitetar soluções complexas do zero em projetos de alta escala ou missão crítica, mantendo sempre o foco na qualidade, resiliência, custo-eficiência e na excelência da experiência do usuário final.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções tecnológicas complexas iniciando do zero;
  • Atuar em projetos de alta escala e de missão crítica, garantindo a estabilidade operacional;
  • Liderar tecnicamente e mentorar profissionais de níveis júnior, pleno e sênior;
  • Garantir a qualidade, resiliência e a relação custo-benefício (custo-eficiência) das soluções entregue;
  • Promover a integração fluida entre as frentes de Engenharia de Dados, IA/ML e Engenharia de Software.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Eficiência de Modelos: Sucesso na avaliação de modelos através de métricas offline/online, precision-recall, ROC, calibration e business metrics;
  • Qualidade e Monitoramento: Efetividade no monitoramento de dados (Data Quality via Great Expectations, Soda, dbt tests) e observabilidade ponta a ponta (Latência das APIs, uptime dos pipelines de dados e sucesso no processamento distribuído -Spark);
  • Performance de ML: Controle de drift e performance de modelos em produção (Evidently AI);
  • Estabilidade de Sistemas: Performance e observabilidade através de profiling, tracing distribuído e logging estruturado;
  • Resiliência e Segurança: Redução de incidentes de segurança (OWASP Top 10) e conformidade com políticas de governança e ética em IA;
  • Impacto no Usuário: Nível de excelência e satisfação na experiência do usuário final com as ferramentas e assistentes desenvolvidos;
  • Nível avançado/especialista em Engenharia de Dados e IA/Machine Learning, com senioridade em Engenharia de Software;
  • Generalista técnico com visão sistêmica e autonomia para arquitetar soluções do zero em projetos de missão crítica. Capacidade comprovada de liderança técnica;
  • Educação/Base: Sólido conhecimento em estatística (descritiva, inferencial e testes de hipóteses) e modelagem de dados.

Engenharia de Dados:

  • Domínio avançado de SQL (queries complexas, otimização, window functions) e modelagem de dados;
  • Experiência sólida com ETL/ELT em escala, incluindo design de pipelines resilientes;
  • Bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL), não relacional (MongoDB) e vetoriais (Milvus, Pinecone, S3 Vector);
  • Integração com APIs externas e fontes de dados exógenas (REST, GraphQL, webhooks);
  • Cloud distribuída: AWS avançado (EC2, ECS/Fargate, S3, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch);
  • Streaming de dados em tempo real (Apache Kafka);
  • Processamento distribuído (Apache Spark);
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform);
  • Orquestração de workflows (Apache Airflow);
  • Monitoramento avançado: Data Quality (Great Expectations, Soda, dbt tests);
  • Observability de pipelines (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry), ML monitoring (drift, performance, Evidently AI);
  • Governança de dados (Apache Ranger);
  • Data lake/lakehouse moderno (Iceberg, PyIceberg);
  • Ferramentas de visualização e exploração (Metabase, Power BI).

Engenharia de IA / Machine Learning:

  • Sólida base em estatística descritiva, inferencial, testes de hipóteses, distribuições;
  • Experiência com modelos supervisionados, não-supervisionados, clustering, recomendação, forecasting;
  • Domínio de avaliação de modelos (métricas offline/online, precision-recall, ROC, calibration, business metrics), test A/B/n, canary, shadow deployment;
  • Criação e produção de IAs conversacionais (assistentes, chatbots, copilots);
  • Arquitetura e implementação de sistemas RAG avançados (retrieval, reranking, chunking inteligente, hybrid search, query transformation) com Vector DBs;
  • Desenvolvimento de Agentes de IA autônomos e multiagentes (LangChain,LangGraph, LangFuse);
  • Criação de Agent as a Service, orquestração de agentes, tool calling, reasoning loops;
  • Experiência com Model Context Protocol (MCP): implementação de MCP Clients e
  • MCP Servers, integração de ferramentas externas e dados proprietários em agentes;
  • MLOps: versionamento (MLflow, DVC), feature store, serving (Sagemaker, KServe,
  • BentoML, vLLM), monitoring de modelos em produção;
  • Conhecimento prático de LLMs (prompt engineering avançado, evaluation
  • frameworks);
  • Familiaridade com ética em IA, bias mitigation, explainability (SHAP, LIME).

Engenharia de Software:

  • Python avançado (typing, async/await, decorators, generators, context managers,
  • metaprogramming);
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST/GraphQL escaláveis (FastAPI, Django REST Framework);
  • Design de sistemas CRUD, microsserviços, event-driven architecture;
  • Testes automatizados (pytest, unittest, TDD/BDD, property-based testing, mocking);
  • CI/CD moderno (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins);
  • Contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS);
  • Clean Code, design patterns, SOLID, DDD quando aplicável;
  • Segurança de aplicações (OWASP Top 10, secrets management, JWT/OAuth, rate
  • limiting);
  • Performance e observabilidade (profiling, tracing distribuído, logging estruturado).


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Gestão de equipes;
  • Vivência com metodologia ágil;
  • Conhecimento em produtos TOTVS.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Coffee Trader
description:
Company Introduction

Xiamen C&D Merchandise Co.,Ltd, a member of C&D Inc. Consumer Goods Division, connects global high-quality resources and empowers the supply chain ecosystem in the consumer sector. We are committed to providing integrated services such as procurement, processing, distribution, and logistics for raw material suppliers and brand operators to enter domestic and international markets swiftly and compliantly. By collaborating with upstream and downstream industries, we continuously improve supply chain transaction and delivery efficiency, ensuring products reach markets and consumers more effectively.

Job description


  1. Develop and execute sales plans to achieve the company's sales targets. Proactively seek new clients while maintaining and expanding existing client relationships to enhance market share and sales performance.
  2. Formulate marketing strategies and plans, participate in the planning and execution of marketing promotion activities such as exhibitions, to enhance the company's visibility and establish a favorable image within the industry.
  3. Track order execution to ensure accurate and timely delivery of coffee beans. Provide excellent after-sales service to clients, handle client complaints and issues. Promptly communicate with relevant departments to ensure issues are properly resolved.
  4. Adhere to the company's rules and regulations and various management systems to ensure the compliance and efficiency of sales activities.
  5. Develop coffee bean procurement plans based on the company's sales plans, inventory levels, and market demands, including determining the quantity, varieties, and grades of purchases.
  6. Ensure the timely, qualitative, and quantitative execution of procurement plans, maintain close communication with suppliers, and coordinate to resolve issues arising during the procurement process.
  7. Screen and evaluate potential coffee bean suppliers, establish long-term and stable cooperative relationships with high-quality suppliers to ensure stable supply and price advantages of coffee beans.
  8. Conduct detailed analysis of procurement costs, formulate procurement budgets based on the company's financial status and sales plans, and strictly control expense outflows during the procurement process.
  9. Collect market information on coffee green beans, understand competitors' procurement strategies and pricing levels, and provide a basis for the company to formulate procurement strategies.

  • Ensure compliance and accuracy across multi-transactional processes, including documentation and forms, delivering on time every time.
What We’re Looking For
  • Proven experience managing U.S. benefits enrollment cycles and renewals.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to balance multiple priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills—approachable, relatable, and confident.
  • Experience with benefits governance and process improvement.
  • Project management exposure and ability to support strategic initiatives.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to compliance and timely delivery.
What you can expect from us
We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.
You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.
And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.
Our approach to Flexible Working
At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.
We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.
For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found (here)

title: Senior Benefits Specialist
description:
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. We combine deep insight, advanced technology, and close collaboration to help our clients grow, innovate, and deliver measurable value for their customers.

dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever and Metro.

We’re looking for a Senior Benefits Specialist (Senior Reward Analyst) who expects more from their career. It’s a chance to extend and improve dunnhumby’s HR Global Benefits Team It’s an opportunity to work with a market-leading business to explore new opportunities for us and influence global retailers.

Joining our Global Benefits team, you’ll work with world class and passionate people to support our global renewals, working closely with our brokers, leading benchmarking reviews, taking tactical and strategic Global Benefit projects as well as enrollment and benefit supplier management.

What we expect from you

  • Experienced management of US cyclical enrollment, reporting, launch, communication
  • A track record of rolling out Benefits packages and renewals (global preferable)
  • Confident ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders, both internally and externally and be relatable and approachable
  • Provide recommendations for benefits practice and governance ensuring that approved standards are communicated, followed and remain effective
  • Confident in your approach and how you manage and organise your day to day is essential. Dealing with tricky and sometimes complex queries whilst not letting other work deadlines.
  • Has some project exposure with the ability to track, manage and support strategic initiatives
  • Comfortable and confident with following multi transactional processes. Ensuring documents, forms, compliance is met to deadline, on time, every time, balancing delivery dates and detail.


What You Can Expect From Us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found (here)

title: Finance Manager
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Finance Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and overseeing all financial operations for our Brazil entity, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement across accounting, reporting, and internal controls.

Reporting into the Brazil Controller you will serve as the primary finance lead for Brazil, taking full ownership of local statutory and regulatory obligations while partnering closely with cross-functional and global teams. This is a hands-on leadership role that requires a strong combination of technical accounting expertise, process-driven thinking, and the ability to navigate Brazil's complex regulatory environment.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth setting and is passionate about building robust financial processes from the ground up. You will play a critical role in strengthening our financial foundation in Brazil as SHEIN continues to expand its presence in the region.


This role will be based in our office in São Paulo.



Responsibilities

  • Lead and support the internalization and implementation of accounting systems , ensuring seamless integration with existing internal controls and financial processes.
  • Build and continuously improve internal controls, financial systems, and processes to guarantee accuracy of financial reporting, integrity of corporate data, compliance with finance governance, and safeguarding of assets.
  • Take accountability for all local statutory, regulatory, and internal compliance requirements (taxes, financial reporting, solicitor account rules, financial controls, and policies), as well as accounting records and financial processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Group and regional teams on matters such as transfer pricing , international mobility, partner tax and accounting issues, direct and indirect taxation.
  • Monitor and navigate the evolving regulatory landscape, staying up to date with IRS, SEC, and other relevant rules and regulations.
  • Build strong relationships with regional auditors and manage the statutory audit process.


Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of hands-on global or regional accounting experience.
  • CPA or CA certification.
  • Bachelor's Degree;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong self-management skills with proven ability to work independently and resourcefully.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Ability to deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines, managing multiple projects simultaneously with exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience in accounting system implementation and integration projects.



At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.

Movimento audacioso, energia positiva e trabalho de qualidade; este é o nosso DNA Hyundai; este foi o poder que nos permitiu ser líder global na indústria automotiva e será o poder para criar um novo mundo. Estamos em busca de talentos que escreverão uma nova página de nossa história com o DNA Hyundai.


Venha crescer conosco!!!

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

title: Head of Gaming, Brazil
description:
At bet365, we're one of the world's leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 9,000 people and serve over 100 million customers in 27 languages. Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, offering an unmatched experience across 96 sports and 700,000 streaming events. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe, we handle over 6 billion HTTP requests daily and process more than 2 million bets per hour at peak.


We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of opportunities for growth, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our customers worldwide.


Job Description


As the Head of Gaming, Brazil, you will lead strategic initiatives to enhance our gaming portfolio across Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo and will be responsible for the financial performance of gaming operations in the region, executing the strategy set by the CPO and ensuring alignment with the overall business strategy, while maximising player engagement and revenue growth.


We are looking for a dynamic and experienced leader with a proven track record in the iGaming industry who possesses strong commercial acumen, exceptional leadership skills, and a deep understanding of what makes an exceptional localised Gaming Product.


You will develop and execute a comprehensive gaming strategy tailored to the Brazilian market, collaborating closely with the central Product team. This strategy will aim to achieve set financial targets for Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo in each market.


Your role will involve identifying growth opportunities and ensuring the delivery of product and content roadmaps in the region. You will leverage customer and data insights to inform strategies, working with marketing and CRM teams to ensure their approaches align with key product initiatives. Additionally, you will build and mentor a high-performing team, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.


Qualifications


  • Significant experience in a senior role within the iGaming industry.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth and operational excellence.
  • In-depth knowledge of games and game types within Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo.
  • Exceptional leadership and team management skills.
  • Experience in product development and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent analytical and strategic thinking abilities.
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience with supplier management.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Passion for innovation and enhancing player experiences.
  • Familiarity with market research and competitive analysis.


Additional Information


  • Developing and executing a comprehensive gaming strategy tailored to Brazil while ensuring it meets and exceeds financial targets for gaming revenue.
  • Identifying and evaluating growth opportunities, including new market expansions, partnerships, and product offerings.
  • Developing and executing a commercial strategy that aligns with regional objectives, working closely with central commercial teams to maximise revenue opportunities.
  • Overseeing the end-to-end product lifecycle for gaming offerings, working with the central Product teams to ensure that products are tailored to meet market preferences and requirements.
  • Establishing clear milestones and timelines for game releases, updates, and integrations, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high quality.
  • Collaborating with Marketing and CRM teams to optimise player engagement and offers, and design tailored promotions and rewards for players in Brazil.
  • Leveraging customer and data insights to inform strategies and decision-making, and conducting market research and competitive analysis to inform product development and identify emerging trends and customer needs.
  • Building, leading, and mentoring a high-performing gaming team, fostering a culture of collaboration.
  • Taking responsibility for the financial performance of Gaming in the region, ensuring that revenue targets are met and profitability is maximised, while regularly reporting performance metrics to the CPO and other key stakeholders.
  • Serving as the voice of the customer, ensuring Gaming products address player needs.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

title: Consultor Manutenção Mecânica - secagem
description:
Sobre a vaga


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.


Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.


Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência


Sobre o papel

Garantir que equipamentos e sistemas da sua área de atuação, funcionem de forma eficiente e segura, evitando paradas não programadas e interrupções da produção por manutenções de emergência, através de monitoramento de desempenho e demais indicadores, assegurando custos de manutenção adequados, planos de manutenção eficientes e gestão técnica dos times de manutentores.


Atividades principais :

  • Criar e otimizar planos de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, dos equipamentos de sua área de atuação, estabelecendo cronogramas de manutenção e garantindo e execução da manutenção com a eficiência necessária evitando quebras e impactos na produção;
  • Monitorar o desempenho dos equipamentos e sistemas, utilizando ferramentas de diagnóstico e análise de dados, identificando padrões de falhas, criando e implementando ações para melhorar a confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos equipamentos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com o time de engenharia, produção e segurança, apoiando e executando projetos de melhorias, inovação, modificações e modernização de instalações, máquinas e equipamentos, normas e planos de manutenção, identificando causa raiz, apresentando soluções corretivas e preventivas, evitando recorrências, otimizando custos e aumentando a disponibilidade das máquinas e equipamentos;
  • Treinar e orientar tecnicamente os times de manutenção, nos procedimentos e melhores práticas, promovendo a melhoria contínua das habilidades e conhecimento, bem como, assegurando que o time esteja treinado e capacitado para assumir as atividades de manutenção após o startup da planta, disponibilizando ferramentas, recursos técnicos e humanos para apoiar os fornecedores dos equipamentos e tecnologias;
  • Realizar análise dos modos de falha (FMEA) dos sistemas e equipamentos críticos da área de atuação, realizar análise de falha e aplicar metodologia e ferramentas de engenharia (RCA, FTA, RCM, Ishikawa, etc.).
  • Elaborar escopos de contratação de serviços terceirizados de manutenção, participando ativamente das etapas de negociação e avaliação técnica, assegurando as melhores práticas, custos adequados, qualidade, segurança e a confiabilidade em todo o processo;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de planejamento e execução da Parada Geral da planta, realizando o mapeamento das atividades de manutenção, através de alinhamento com a gerência de produção, mitigando os riscos e impactos gerados, desenvolvendo estratégias e plano de ação, avaliando e desenvolvendo fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, sempre prezando pela segurança e otimização dos custos;
  • Implantar, monitorar e analisar diariamente os indicadores de desempenho da sua área de atuação (Custos, disponibilidade, produtividade, estoque de peças de reposição etc.), viabilizando ajustes no planejamento, procedimentos e nos processos;
  • Auxiliar na gestão dos custos da sua área de atuação, realizando a previsão do orçamento anual de (Spend e Headcount), incluindo custos de peças, mão de obra e outros recursos, assim como, acompanhar mensalmente os custos realizados, alocando corretamente nas contas contábeis, apresentando e validando com o gestor imediato durante as reuniões de análise crítica, visando o cumprimento do orçamento e otimização dos custos;
  • Cumprir, fazer cumprir e promover os padrões de segurança e regulamentações aplicadas às pessoas e aos equipamentos, através da realização de avaliação de riscos e implantação de medidas, alinhas à gestão;
  • Garantir que as atividades de manutenção estejam alinhadas aos objetivos e requisitos da área cliente, através de alinhamento e interação com a área demandante, para entendimento da necessidade e expectativa de prazos e qualidade da entrega;
  • Outras atividades correlatas;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;


Qualificações :

  • Conhecimento em Metrologia, Medição de dimensional com Instrumentos;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas dedicados, equipamentos rotativos (redutores, bombas, agitadores, ventiladores);

  • Gerenciar KPIs e análises avançadas por meio de Power BI e Excel .
  • Preparar relatórios executivos e apresentações para lideranças locais e globais.
  • Coordenar o fluxo de materiais, disponibilidade de produtos e embarques mensais de contratos long‑term e spot.
  • Atuar diretamente com shipping lines, brokers, transportadoras, fornecedores e unidades de produção .
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e otimizar custos logísticos.
  • Ser a ponte entre a operação brasileira e times globais (Singapura, Genebra, México e outros).
  • Realizar visitas a plantas, fornecedores, distribuidores e demais parceiros.


O que precisa para ser bem-sucedido


Buscamos um profissional com raciocínio analítico, forte organização, visão integrada de logística e operações, além de facilidade de comunicação em ambientes multiculturais e de alta complexidade.

  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e madura.

  • Perfil analítico, atento a dados e indicadores.

  • Mandarim intermediário ou avançado.
  • Experiência com negociação de fretes, shipping lines e brokers.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em uma operação global de alta relevância, com forte exposição internacional, interação direta com produção, logística global e trading, além de grande autonomia para propor melhorias e elevar o nível de eficiência operacional da cadeia.
